notes.title: Demo Hot Fix 1.1
notes.content: [h3]Hi there fellow Fleet Commanders![/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who tried out the demo![/p][p]I've listened to your feedback and made some changes, I hope you like them![/p][p][/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]The AI difficulty in the first levels has been better balanced.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI now handles deadlock situations more effectively.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a VSync option to the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added frame rate limit options for both the menu and in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]The typing effect in dialogue boxes is now faster.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Minor GUI fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your feedback.[/p]

tags.balance_change: The AI difficulty in the first levels has been better balanced.
The AI now handles deadlock situations more effectively.

tags.feature: Added a VSync option to the settings menu.
Added frame rate limit options for both the menu and in-game.

tags.balance_change: The typing effect in dialogue boxes is now faster.
